subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Who will establish and attest official custody of the production GitHub OAuth application and rotate its Convex production credentials?
rationale: The remedy requires privileged GitHub application ownership and production secret access that repository automation cannot inspect or modify safely.

options.title: Rotate to official app
options.body: Transfer or create an officially owned ClawHub OAuth app, rotate production credentials, and attach redacted browser and CLI authorization proof.

options.title: Attest existing custody
options.body: If the existing app is intentionally retained, document its approved organizational custody and provide live proof that the displayed identity meets the project’s trust requirements.

recommendation.title: Rotate to official app
recommendation.body: Transfer or create an officially owned ClawHub OAuth app, rotate production credentials, and attach redacted browser and CLI authorization proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account was assigned the earlier report concerning the same production OAuth operation.
